div.span:
1. OBSERVE
workflow traces, agent
meta-commentary, eval metrics

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
2. EVALUATE vs Benchmark
schema quality P/R | extraction F1
composite: schema 40% + extraction 60%

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
3. DIAGNOSE
lowest-accuracy fields | hardest papers
error types: omission, hallucination, wrong value
schema convergence: rate of change, entropy

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
4. PROPOSE Changes
generate instruction file diffs
each change tied to diagnosis rationale

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span:
5. APPLY & LOG
apply diffs | log iteration # + metrics
snapshot current state

span.p:
Stopping Rules
< 1% improvement over 3 iterations
hard cap: 10 iterations
overfitting: metrics drop on new papers

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Disputed Values Log
(system consistently disagrees
with gold standard)

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KEY: System 2 modifies INSTRUCTIONS only
never touches schema, data, or normalization tables directly
